nadfe46a8e7.headline: Fund investing Babiš's money sold offices in Ostrava for more than 1.4 billion | Aktuálně.cz
nadfe46a8e7.summary: Orchard Office Park, the largest modern office complex in Ostrava, was sold by a fund investing money linked to Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babiš for more than 1.4 billion Czech crowns.
nadfe46a8e7.why: Large real estate transactions reflect investment trends and liquidity in the Czech commercial property market.
